description: Concurrent Force Reporter diagnostics. For each result source the plugin reads (beam, truss, plate, general link, elastic link, node reaction, node displacement), asks this CIVIL NX build with one item of that kind which table token answers, the columns it returns and how they map, the output-point tokens, and the result series published. Use it when concurrent_forces reports a missing table, column or series. Read-only.

units.description: Units to report in (MIDAS converts). Default: the model's own.
